t_advice_summary_textbox.text: When choosing a colour, keep an eye on the points it earns you and make sure you pick the colour that seems to get the most points, but keep an eye on it changing throughout just in case.

vb_textbox.text: Select the colour you want first and see how many points it gains you; as you go along keep an eye on which colours are earning you more points and stick with those BUT keep in mind they do change over time, take notice and you will get more points.
